items.title: For a proper curve over a separably closed field cohomology is unchanged by extension of the base field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma extends the invariance of etale cohomology of torsion sheaves on a proper curve from algebraically closed to separably closed base fields (statement lines 15768-15776). The proof (proof lines 15778-15801) passes to algebraic closures, uses pure inseparability and topological invariance to identify the two cohomologies with those on the closure models, and then applies the algebraically closed case. H2: one reduction through topological invariance.
